status: local protocol before any outcome computation
target: state at t+1, reports from t-age only; no future report available
generator: two binary Markov context states, initial flip probability .08; after time 230 main worlds flip .2 and first four source reliabilities reverse; 8 sources with fixed hidden rates .55-.9 except last two .2-.4; ages 0,1,3,8, duplicates, inactivity, wrong context and absent reports
learned: Beta(2,2) source-by-age accuracy to future target estimated only from train; no true reliability/flip parameter supplied to any predictor
budget: maximum 4 decoded independent eligible votes per prediction for every method; all headers may be inspected; source-age weights learned once, not from evaluation labels; fixed graph models use same top-4 evidence as LearnedGraph4
routing: sort eligible lineage headers by absolute learned log likelihood; adaptive begins with 2 votes then opens until absolute logodds >= logit(.85) or four votes; compare recursive vs ordinary sequential implementation
model_fits: one fixed Logistic C=1 max_iter=1000 and HGB max_iter=100 max_leaf_nodes=15 l2=1 per seed, no search
calibration: sigmoid on calibration only; raw and calibrated metrics preserved; no shift refit
primary: calibrated Brier AdaptivePortal minus best conventional baseline, separately chronological/unseen/shift; report world-clustered bootstrap 1000 draws; no superiority if tie or loss
hard_negative: false future target with any eligible decoded positive report, evaluation-only slice
stop: five seed families once, preserve failures and never retune on outcomes
platform: execute exact frozen code locally and in Colab CPU, record versions; compare source/predictions with stated tolerance across versions; GPU only if workload warrants it and cost/access is checked
scope: authored synthetic chronological simulation; not empirical real-event forecasting, native SRDE or human cognition validation
